trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis**
- v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

**Actions taken**
1. Rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0**. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted rollout after us-east), so I verified status and retried — the second attempt rolled out v2.3.0 to all regions successfully.
2. Confirmed the service is now **healthy across all regions** with an error rate of ~0.2%.
3. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 health check failures") with a full summary; the on-call engineer has been paged.

**Follow-up recommendation:** v2.3.1 was also unhealthy in staging, so investigate the regression there before attempting a redeploy.
